# BioInsights Publishing

> > Open access peer-reviewed journals and webinars advancing life sciences innovation in cell therapy, gene therapy, nucleic acid therapeutics, vaccines, and bioconjugates.

BioInsights Publishing is a platform for open access, peer-reviewed scientific content focused on cutting-edge biotechnology and therapeutic development. The site hosts specialized journals and live webinars featuring expert discussions on manufacturing, clinical applications, and emerging technologies in cell and gene therapy, mRNA therapeutics, and immunotherapy.

## Key Topics

- CAR-T cells
- mRNA manufacturing
- cell therapy
- gene therapy
- bioconjugation
- nucleic acid therapeutics
- immunotherapy
- electroporation
- affinity chromatography
- vaccine development
- clinical manufacturing
- open access publishing
- peer-reviewed journals
- dsRNA removal
- transposon technology

## Peer-Reviewed Journals

- [Bioconjugate Insights](https://www.insights.bio/bioconjugate-insights): Peer-reviewed journal covering antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) and bioconjugation technologies
- [Cell and Gene Therapy Insights](https://www.insights.bio/cell-and-gene-therapy-insights): Journal on advanced cell and gene therapies including CAR-T engineering and manufacturing
- [Nucleic Acid Insights](https://www.insights.bio/nucleic-acid-insights): Journal covering mRNA, oligonucleotides, and nucleic acid-based therapeutics
- [Vaccine Insights](https://www.insights.bio/vaccine-insights): Peer-reviewed journal on vaccine research, development, and manufacturing
- [Immuno-oncology Insights](https://www.insights.bio/immuno-oncology-insights): Archived journal on CAR-T cells and cancer immunotherapy approaches

## Webinar Series

- [Achieving >80-fold reduction in dsRNA from mRNA feeds using affinity chromatography](https://www.insights.bio/nucleic-acid-insights/webinars/822/achieving-80fold-reduction-in-dsrna-from-mrna-feeds-using-affinity-chromatography): Live webinar on advanced dsRNA removal techniques for mRNA manufacturing quality
- [Clinical-scale manufacturing of transposon-based CAR-T cells using next-generation electroporation](https://www.insights.bio/cell-and-gene-therapy-insights/webinars/814/clinicalscale-manufacturing-of-transposonbased-cart-cells-using-nextgeneration-electroporation): Webinar on scaling transposon-based CAR-T cell manufacturing with electroporation technology
- [Engineering armored CAR-T cells to overcome the solid tumor microenvironment](https://www.insights.bio/cell-and-gene-therapy-insights/webinars/818/engineering-armored-cart-cells-to-overcome-the-solid-tumor-microenvironment): Expert discussion on armored CAR-T cell engineering strategies for solid tumor immunotherapy
- [Proactively mitigating contamination risk across the end-to-end cell therapy manufacturing workflow](https://www.insights.bio/cell-and-gene-therapy-insights/webinars/816/proactively-mitigating-contamination-risk-across-the-endtoend-cell-therapy-manufacturing-workflow): Webinar on contamination control, mycoplasma detection, and quality assurance in cell therapy
- [Precision bioconjugation and intracellular trafficking assays to uncover therapeutic antibody performance](https://www.insights.bio/bioconjugate-insights/webinars/819/precision-bioconjugation-and-intracellular-trafficking-assays-to-uncover-therapeutic-antibody-performance): Webinar on ADC characterization and therapeutic antibody intracellular trafficking analysis
- [Addressing variability in pathology assessment across global clinical trials](https://www.insights.bio/cell-and-gene-therapy-insights/webinars/811/addressing-variability-in-pathology-assessment-across-global-clinical-trials): Webinar on standardizing pathology assessment protocols in multinational clinical trials
